items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Joe Williams happened to be in town, and he came and sat in.

ctx.x: And Joe Williams happened to be in town, and he came and sat in. And like the whole South Side came down, it was wild. Even Freddie Green played a solo.
Was - I’m trying to think - was Duffy Jackson with them at the time?
